title: School Caretaker
pay: Up to £36,000 a year, depending on experience
summary: Look after the sites of Ofsted Outstanding therapeutic schools in Essex. Driving licence and own vehicle essential.
body:
## The position

An exciting opportunity for a school caretaker to make a meaningful impact on pupils' lives at trauma-informed therapeutic schools in Essex. Since 2012 the organisation's settings in London and Essex have been recognised for exceptional practice, and they are rated Outstanding in all areas by Ofsted.

They're looking for a full-time caretaker to join the Essex team on a 3 to 6 month fixed-term contract, starting as soon as possible. A full driving licence and your own vehicle are essential, as you'll travel between sites.

You'll be the first point of contact for all premises issues, including emergencies, and act as the health and safety representative for the cluster. Your practical skills, problem-solving and attention to detail will keep the schools safe, compliant and welcoming for pupils and staff.

## The role

- Carry out regular site checks, maintenance and repairs, in line with health and safety legislation and independent school standards.
- Respond promptly to maintenance requests, prioritising safety and efficiency.
- Oversee external contractors, making sure work is completed to a high standard and within budget.
- Keep accurate records of maintenance, inspections and compliance documents.
- Take pride in keeping the school sites well presented, safe and functional.

## Benefits

- New, highly competitive pay scales.
- Be part of a unique, seamless therapeutic team model.
- Vitality private healthcare, including health, medical and dental insurance, lifestyle benefits, heavily discounted gym membership and rewards.
- High-quality professional development and career progression, with up to 100% funding towards relevant qualifications.

## About the employer

Our client prides itself on being an exceptional employer, with a supportive, inclusive culture that puts the wellbeing of staff and pupils first. Join a team committed to making a meaningful difference to students' lives while advancing your career in a nurturing, rewarding environment.
